args.title: Fix weekly summary delivery time for Bengaluru users to 08:00
args.body:
File: none

Adjust the scheduled task or timezone handling that triggers the weekly summary email so that users in the Asia/Kolkata timezone (Bengaluru) receive it at 08:00 local time instead of 08:30. The current setup delivers it late, causing the Monday stand-up to start without the latest numbers. This change proposes to correct the timing offset for that timezone.
